note: Pilot evaluation set. Difficulty tiers follow Spider's taxonomy (number of tables joined and clause complexity). Gold SQL is hand-written and verified to execute against data/chinook.sqlite.

questions.question: How many tracks are in the database?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

questions.question: How many customers are from Germany?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany'

questions.question: What is the unit price of the track called Solitary?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT UnitPrice FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Solitary'

questions.question: List the names of all playlists.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist

questions.question: Which countries do our customers come from? List each country once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

questions.question: What is the longest track in milliseconds?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM Track

questions.question: Which artist has the most albums?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(al.AlbumId) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many tracks does the album Let There Be Rock contain?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

questions.question: Who is the composer of the track Snowballed?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Snowballed'

questions.question: What is the total amount invoiced to customers in the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'USA'

questions.question: How many tracks belong to the Jazz genre?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

questions.question: List the first and last names of employees who report to Nancy Edwards.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

questions.question: Which five customers have spent the most in total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many invoices were billed to Berlin?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCity = 'Berlin'

questions.question: Which genre generated the most total revenue from invoice line sales?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which artist earned the most revenue from track sales?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many tracks by AC/DC appear on playlists?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TrackId) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

questions.question: Which sales support employee is responsible for the customer who spent the most?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List genres that have more than 500 tracks, with their track counts.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 500

questions.question: What is the average invoice total for customers in Canada?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'

questions.question: Which media type is used by the most tracks that appear on the Music playlist?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT mt.Name FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE p.Name = 'Music' GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which country's customers have the highest average invoice total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.Country FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY AVG(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Name the artists who have more albums than the average number of albums per artist.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId))

questions.question: For each genre, how much revenue came from customers in the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE c.Country = 'USA' GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

questions.question: Which tracks appear on at least four different playlists?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId, t.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) >= 4
